source: Gyroid: single effective amplitude fitted to hot-side Q of 30 experiments using the full homogenized model; 8 retrospective holdouts. Diamond: same relative change transferred without fitting Diamond. Calibration solver: 99a1d2d89a9faccb421838d0d8812bf173e076a3. See docs/model-resources.md.
applicability: Total C_eff applied once to the current CFD Nu base, before its existing floor; no extra beta or output-Q correction. Uniform D/G 7 mm cell, 0.6 mm wall, 182x42x42 mm core, existing partial cold ports, variable-property sCO2; calibrated on the 104x24x12 grid with the strict convergence settings in docs/model-resources.md. Grid dependence and cold-side bias remain. Diamond has only three transfer checks and remains underpredicted. Other geometries, grids, flow arrangements and mixed-fluid pairs are unvalidated transfers. This parameter file does not set solver tolerances or establish local-Nu accuracy.
